title: Old man Glenny and his three-string bass
summary: Glenny worked with him for years, began on a three-string bass and used the bow, which Cleo took from him.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Oh yeah. Well speaking of bass players again, is there anything you can tell us about old man Glennie? How was he to work with? I knew him.
Oh yeah, that's how I worked with that old man Glennie. I mean, he worked with me for years and years. He worked with me for years and years old man Glennie. Every job I had he worked.
You started out with him and he had a three string bass. I heard he used to just have three strings on it.
He had three and he got four after.
I knew him when he had four. I never saw him at three.
He had three. When he first started with me he had three. He used to have bow all the time. I mean, the last time he'd pick like them. I mean, he saw them numbers. You could hear him just as plain.
Do you remember what three strings he had with the three highs or the three hoes?

I really don't know. I know you could hear him. I'm telling you, you could hear him. Yeah. Yeah, you could hear him. Even with the bow. Oh yeah, with the bow. He used that bow. He used that bow. Actually, Cleo got that from him.
